exposure: severity of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (IHCP)
cohort: 100 pregnant women experiencing symptoms of pruritus, likely indicating obstetric cholestasis or IHCP.
finding: The study observed mostly favorable perinatal outcomes, including favorable birth weight and Apgar scores, and no neonatal mortality, in pregnant women with obstetric cholestasis, though one stillbirth occurred in the severe cholestasis group.
gest_age: Majority at or after 37 weeks of gestation
